fieldValues.title: A meeting can be worked in a copy of the master and only its outcomes merged back
fieldValues.summary: A third real meeting was run in a copy of the master; 129 outcome records and 105 relations merged back with repo merge-apply, 120 working records and 321 relations stayed in the meeting file, and that file was attached to the meeting record. A separate repository is refused: only copies of one repository merge.
evidence: 2026-11-27: merge-preview offered 251 instances and 426 relations; merge-apply of the chosen 129 and 105 succeeded; master validates with 0 errors at 609 records (729 had the meeting been kept in full)
Meeting file (a slice of the working copy): 684 KB, attached as a source document
merge-preview from a slice into a different repository: refused, only copies of the same repository can be merged
fieldValues.body: It uses only what the engine has. Two things to settle: the 59 precedent checks came across but their links to decision points did not, because decision points were left in the working layer, so decision points belong with the outcomes; and nothing in the master can point into the attached file, so a minute's evidence is one file away rather than one link away.
